data.one_liner: Flutter package for place search using MapBox API and static map image generation.
data.what_it_does: Provides easy API calls to MapBox Search API for forward geocoding, reverse geocoding, search box suggestions, batch geocoding, and static map image generation with markers and polylines.
use_when: You need Mapbox geocoding or search functionality in your app
You want to generate static map images with polylines and markers
avoid_when: You require a fully interactive embedded map widget (use a map rendering package instead)
You are using Google Maps services instead of Mapbox
strengths: Supports modern Mapbox APIs including SearchBox and Batch Geocoding
Includes static map image generation with custom markers and paths
Uses safe ApiResponse records to handle success and failure flows
weaknesses: Does not render interactive map views, only handles API calls and static images
data.setup_notes: Acquire an API key on the Mapbox website and initialize it globally by calling MapBoxSearch.init('API KEY') in your main function.

alternatives.name: geocoding
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using platform-native geocoding services rather than Mapbox specifically.

data.minimal_example:
var geocoding = GeoCoding(apiKey: 'API Key', limit: 5);
Future<ApiResponse<List<MapBoxPlace>>> getPlaces() => geocoding.getPlaces('central park');
